blockers.title: GitHub autonomous merge and required-check authority is not established
blockers.description: AGENTS.md reserves repository security settings and main merges for explicit owner authorization. CI can be prepared in a PR, but rulesets, merge queue, tokens/secrets, and unattended merge acceptance require owner action.
blockers.next_step: Keep PR-based integration; prepare a least-privilege setup checklist without changing repository settings.

blockers.title: Baseline branch head and complete CI workflow inventory need fresh verification
blockers.description: The reboot-core base SHA and all 15 workflow filenames in the candidate's removal diff have been identified. Nine workflows have successful baseline runs. The remaining work is a policy/compatibility audit, tracked separately as BLK-003.
blockers.next_step: No action; retain the baseline workflow inventory as evidence.

blockers.title: Unified CI candidate needs safety and cost corrections before port
blockers.description: The reboot-core fast runner now corrects deleted-file selection, project-control path coverage, and suite-selection tests. The unified workflow branch additionally restricts pushes, normalizes concurrency, makes the E-002 matrix manual-only, and labels CPU model runs as diagnostic. Remaining risk is authoritative execution after the base branch contains the new workflow.
blockers.next_step: Keep the migration PR stacked on PR #64; after PR #64 is integrated, retarget and run the unified workflow before merging it.

blockers.title: Decision-grade M3 model evaluation needs an approved GPU or API execution path
blockers.description: The unified workflow retains the existing Ollama/Qwen3 CPU job only as a manual diagnostic. It cannot be used to satisfy the v0.1 M3 acceptance gate, which requires a strong model and representative stochastic cohorts on an approved GPU or API path.
blockers.next_step: Obtain owner approval for a bounded API/GPU budget and credentials/runner before enabling the decision-grade cohort.
